About Litecoin

Litecoin is one of the oldest cryptocurrencies, created in 2011 as a faster, lighter alternative to Bitcoin. It uses proof-of-work (Scrypt) with a maximum supply of 84 million coins.

Where this LTC price comes from

The price above updates live in your browser from Coinbase (LTC-USD), Binance (LTC/USDT) and Kraken (LTC/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 77,773,000 LTC (supply last updated October 30, 2026).
